items.title: Foundry Launches SmartRoto AI Plugin for Nuke
items.excerpt: Foundry announced SmartRoto, an AI-powered plugin for Nuke that automates one of VFX's most tedious jobs, letting artists work up to four times faster while keeping full control over spline adjustments. Foundry demoed it at SIGGRAPH 2026.

items.title: Puget Systems at SIGGRAPH 2026: The Robo Dojo
items.excerpt: Puget Systems' SIGGRAPH 2026 booth spotlighted AI-in-VFX workflows: a real-time MetaHuman driven by body movement, Beeble AI running SwitchLight 3 to generate PBR relighting passes on native 4K footage (used on Corridor Crew's Son of a Dungeon S3), and Keyshot Studio's AI Shots applying generative changes while preserving CAD data.

items.title: SIGGRAPH: 'Kok Boru' Director Amina Omirjan on the Making of Higgsfield AI's New Short
items.excerpt: Higgsfield premiered 'Kok Boru' at SIGGRAPH 2026, a 15-minute historical drama rooted in Central Asian folklore made by a team of 12 in two weeks via a hybrid human-AI pipeline: hand-drawn character designs and painted textures condition the generative AI output shot by shot.
